milestones.title: Cross-surface projection, API and CLI parity

issues.title: Map current capability registry to lifecycle actions
issues.description: Trace actual registered start/get/events, plan.transition, intent realization, devtask, mesh, prs, authorization, releases; record consumers and code owners.

issues.title: Audit Cockpit routes and UI action paths
issues.description: Enumerate existing server routes, HTML semantics, scripts, WebSocket paths, navigation and accessibility; identify disconnected actions.

issues.title: Review current PRs and competing implementation work
issues.description: Fetch open PRs, branches, CI results and relevant issues; integrate work already done, avoid duplicate migrations.

issues.title: Derive execution baseline and evidence gaps
issues.description: Measure running/existing start-to-finish flows, reconnect, state recovery, failure reporting, latency and data freshness.

issues.title: Establish canonical mission intent and graph
issues.description: Create or reconcile canonical project intent and milestones; register each issue with acceptance evidence and relationships.

issues.title: Define unified WorkTarget reference
issues.description: Use existing typed IDs and adapters for intent, milestone, issue, task; preserve reference provenance and canonical ownership.

issues.title: Define WorkRun binding to canonical executions
issues.description: Represent parent/child execution lineage, work target, plan revisions, correlation IDs, policy and evidence without second execution ledger.

issues.title: Derive state machine and progress semantics
issues.description: Define state transitions and distinguish phase, attempt, completion, satisfaction, blocked, failed, stale, unknown and cancelled; reject invented percentages.

issues.title: Expose explainable work dependency graph
issues.description: Project target-to-intent/milestone/issue/task edges, readiness, blocking reasons and resource conflicts from existing models.

issues.title: Reconcile distributed ownership and reconciliation versions
issues.description: Pin repo identity, git revision, lease owner, intent revision, idempotency key and compare-and-set transitions.

issues.title: Start task and issue through canonical capability executor
issues.description: Design and implement guarded launch with real target readiness, plan linkage, response execution ID and refusal diagnostics.

issues.title: Start milestone and intent as durable supervised scopes
issues.description: Expand launch into existing issue/task DAG; avoid marking parent successful because children merely ended.

issues.title: Delegated authority envelope
issues.description: Define scope, repository, capabilities, allowed mutation/merge/deploy boundaries, expiry, budgets and audit for unattended execution.

issues.title: Preflight, dry-run, preview and safety UI
issues.description: Show impacted branches, gates, schedule, peers and authority; use same preflight behavior as CLI/MCP.

issues.title: Idempotent controls and authoritative actions
issues.description: Prevent duplicate launch and race; cancel/pause/resume/retry only where backend supports verified transitions.

issues.title: Discover existing lifecycle and mesh facilities
issues.description: Inventory durable records, peer handover, task claim, available runner and recovery; extend only missing parts.

issues.title: Persist supervision state and heartbeats
issues.description: Survive terminal/browser disconnection, server restart, peer crash and worker compaction; avoid ephemeral in-memory ownership as authority.

issues.title: Auto-dispatch eligible work to authenticated peers
issues.description: Match capability, scope, availability, leases and dependency DAG; enforce ownership, budget, fencing and deterministic replan.

issues.title: Recover stalled or abandoned tasks
issues.description: Bound retries, backoff, lease expiration and duplicate execution; detect non-progress and genuine blockers.

issues.title: Continuous PR convergence integration
issues.description: Connect issue/milestone intent work to existing prs drain; do not create a second merge daemon or bypass required CI.

issues.title: Extend existing execution event envelope
issues.description: Use typed versioned events with IDs, sequence, run and parent references, timestamp, kind, actor and sensitive-data redaction.

issues.title: WebSocket subscription per work scope
issues.description: Authorize project/intent/milestone/issue/task subscriptions through existing server; multiplex child execution events.

issues.title: Replay snapshot and gap repair
issues.description: Implement initial atomic snapshot plus cursor, ordered deduplicated events, bounded replay and snapshot resync on cursor expiration.

issues.title: Backpressure and network lifecycle
issues.description: Ping/pong, throttling, bounded buffers, reconnection with jitter, offline/read-only status and tab suspension.

issues.title: Cross-process live consistency tests
issues.description: Prove restart/reconnect, no lost terminal event, stale snapshot awareness and no cross-project leakage.

issues.title: Implement shared WorkActionBar and permission states
issues.description: Contextual Run, Preview, Pause, Resume, Retry, Cancel, Explain; render enabled only when canonical capability permits.

issues.title: Implement WorkStatus and EvidenceConfidence UI
issues.description: Distinct terminal, tentative, stale, unknown, blocked statuses; accessible textual explanation and source links.

issues.title: Implement LiveProgress and event timeline
issues.description: State and stage visualization with timestamps, attempt histories, current worker, blockers, completion and log links.

issues.title: Implement WorkGraph, inspector and breadcrumb
issues.description: Cytoscape dependent view, SSR list/table fallback, selectable entities with canonical URLs and drill-down.

issues.title: Implement virtualized tables and realtime summaries
issues.description: Flowbite/Tailwind from design tokens and Alpine progressive enhancement; avoid independent frontend state machine.

issues.title: Intent detail: launch and satisfy
issues.description: Display definition, acceptance criteria, coverage, milestone graph, evidence and launch/run controls using intent realization.

issues.title: Milestone detail: execute and supervise
issues.description: Display ready/blocked issues and DAG, batch start, critical path, workers, parent execution and replay.

issues.title: Milestone dashboard and roll-up
issues.description: Derive status from children plus acceptance evidence; aggregate exact counts and backed timestamps, not arbitrary percentages.

issues.title: Plan refinement under existing governance
issues.description: Offer capability-authorized plan updates with before/after graph and invariant checks; prevent unauthorized scope drift.

issues.title: Navigation and deep-link restoration
issues.description: Stable routable URLs, browser reload and back button, current selection, filtering and sharing.

issues.title: Issue detail: run + transitions
issues.description: Wire issue execution and plan.transition to same canonical executor; show readiness, linked intent, milestone, task and PRs.

issues.title: Task detail and worker controls
issues.description: Run/retry/cancel with worker claim and locks, live output, test evidence and recovery status.

issues.title: PR drain board and integration actions
issues.description: Display true PR mergeability, gates, conflicts, retry actions and relations; use existing prs commands.

issues.title: Execution logs and artifacts
issues.description: Stream redacted stdout/stderr/event records, search and downloads from trusted endpoints; no fake logs.

issues.title: Issue-to-PR-to-release traceability
issues.description: Clickable traversal of run lineage, commits, test evidence, release and deployment verification.

issues.title: Canonical descriptors and typed schemas
issues.description: Expose work launch and status via existing capabilities and metadata, not UI-specific API inventory.

issues.title: REST and OpenAPI projection
issues.description: Project operations into existing API/Swagger and verify request-response schemas and errors.

issues.title: MCP/CLI execution parity
issues.description: Ensure same authorization, readiness, execution IDs and state transitions from CLI/MCP/HTTP/UI.

issues.title: Web topology and route registration
issues.description: Reuse web::Topology and Cockpit conventions; expose no orphan or duplicate route and no route without navigation.

issues.title: Generated docs and examples
issues.description: Generate public command, endpoint, UI and workflow references from canonical descriptors and test executed examples.

issues.title: AuthN/AuthZ threat-model for websocket and mutations
issues.description: Origin checks, session auth, capability/target scopes, per-event filtering, CSRF and no privilege by peer discovery.

issues.title: Secrets and prompt privacy
issues.description: Redact tokens, credentials, prompts and local-only paths from stream, logs, snapshots, activity and public site.

issues.title: Efficient transport and chart performance
issues.description: Target bounded time-to-first-progress, low idle CPU, lazy graphs, throttled events and bounded log retention.

issues.title: Responsive mobile-first interactions
issues.description: Test 320/375/768/1024/1440 widths, keyboard/focus, drawers, touch targets and reduced-motion modes.

issues.title: Graceful degradation and no-JS correctness
issues.description: Ensure SSR initial state, forms/links, no-JS read-only evidence; unavailable services are clearly reported.

issues.title: Migrate .ai rules/doctrines, deprecate blockers
issues.description: Find conflicting constraints; replace superseded policy with scoped autonomy and verifiable consistency rules.

issues.title: Register executable gates in existing CI model
issues.description: Bind rule proofs to exact tests and gates; impact-select relevant checks, validate no bypass through direct route.

issues.title: Contract and property tests
issues.description: State transitions, idempotency, replay ordering, event loss, parent aggregation, stale plans and cache invalidation.

issues.title: Browser-driven E2E and visual regression
issues.description: Use real isolated repository fixture with real backend behavior, compare user-uploaded screenshots as styling reference only.

issues.title: Chaos and self-hosted dogfooding
issues.description: Kill server/worker, reconnect, stale lease, denied action, race start, failed CI, rejected merge; recover or block truthfully.

issues.title: Canary issue execution through UI
issues.description: Run a low-risk real issue from browser and verify CLI/MCP parity, progress, artifact and completion.

issues.title: Canary milestone and intent supervision
issues.description: Exercise real nested work graph in authorized self-hosted repository through browser, reconnect and resume.

issues.title: Update Docs and living landing page
issues.description: Derived explainable feature sections and examples; claims only reflect shipped functionality with proof and freshness.

issues.title: Version analysis, merge, release and deploy
issues.description: Bump using existing version policy, merge after relevant gates, release and deploy only authorized targets; verify health.

issues.title: Closeout with measurable adoption evidence
issues.description: List URLs, screenshots, tests, event transport measurements, run IDs, deployed SHA, remaining blockers and rollback instructions.
